one_line: Second Sena king of early medieval Bengal, consolidator of Radha, Gauda and Vikrampur.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined, well-trained build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown eastern Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes under defined brows, a neatly trimmed short moustache and light stubble along the jaw; default expression is calm, strategic focus with a hint of stern authority.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, tight warrior topknot (small rounded bun) at the back of the crown, sides smoothly combed back; front has a short central forelock curving slightly over the forehead; he wears a narrow gold-stitched cloth headband in deep maroon tied at the back, just above the brow.
appearance.costume: Over the torso he wears a fitted, sleeveless quilted cotton armour vest (kantha-style padding) dyed deep indigo with closely spaced vertical stitching and a slightly curved neckline, worn over a full-sleeved, light-cream cotton tunic; a broad brick-red silk uttariya (upper cloth) with thin gold borders is wrapped from the left shoulder diagonally across the chest and under the right arm, its end tucked at his waist. His lower garment is a finely pleated ankle-length dhoti in muted off-white, wrapped in the eastern Bengal style with a front fan-like pleat and a narrow maroon border at the edge, secured with a wide woven cloth belt in mustard-yellow and red stripes. Around his shoulders and waist, simple leather straps support a scabbard; he wears minimal but refined jewellery: a pair of small gold kundala earrings, a single narrow gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a plain signet-style ring on his right hand. On his feet are sturdy brown leather sandals with toe straps and side lacing, practical for both court and campaign.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged sword inspired by early medieval Indian kshurapra-type blades, with a 70–75 cm steel blade, simple iron crossguard, gently flared disc-pommel and a wrapped brown leather grip, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings at the mouth and tip.

ref_desc: Vijayasena is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed, mustached man in his early 40s with a black warrior topknot and maroon headband, wearing a deep indigo quilted armour vest over a cream tunic, off-white bordered dhoti, brick-red silk uttariya, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals and carrying a curved single-edged sword in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Vijayasena: a late-30s to early-40s eastern Indian king with an athletic build, medium-brown complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed short moustache and light jaw stubble, his default expression calm and authoritative. His thick black hair is pulled into a high rounded warrior topknot at the back of the crown with a short forelock, and he wears a narrow deep-maroon cloth headband tied at the back. Dress him in an era-accurate early medieval Bengal outfit: a fitted sleeveless deep indigo quilted cotton armour vest with vertical stitching over a full-sleeved light-cream cotton tunic, a broad brick-red silk uttariya with thin gold borders wrapped from his left shoulder across the chest and under the right arm, and an ankle-length off-white dhoti with a subtle maroon border, wrapped in an eastern style with a fan-like front pleat and secured by a wide mustard-yellow and red striped cloth belt. Add simple leather straps supporting a plain dark-brown leather scabbard, small gold kundala earrings, a single narrow gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a plain signet-style ring; put sturdy brown leather sandals on his feet. His signature weapon is a slightly curved single-edged sword with a steel blade, simple iron crossguard, flared disc-pommel and brown leather-wrapped grip, sheathed at his left hip. Show front, side and three-quarter views with consistent colours and details, emphasizing grounded historical realism with clean shonen-anime linework and energy.
